limits: Provisional model-assisted source review; no independent human gold labels or human answer review.
Authored counterfactual fixtures are not real agent trajectories, measured local setups, evaluated model outputs or computed optimization rewards.
Synthetic full-inspection preconditions permit source-scoped gap checks only for this judge sentinel. Future agent scoring requires genuine recorded inspection.
The fixture set was built from already-inspected development papers; it is neither untouched generalization nor certified training/pretraining-disjoint material.
No semantic judge has run. Passing source review does not pass the future32-fixture judging gate, establish population reliability, or authorize training/inference.
The apparent FlashAttention end-to-end self-comparison typo is not silently repaired or used to manufacture target results.

Public file separation does not enforce access control: labels/categories/expected scores must remain outside future judge examples and tuning inputs, and later failure-informed changes retire this validation set.
